Actor Yash's Film 'Toxic' Trailer Released, Featuring Double Role

The trailer for actor Yash's upcoming film 'Toxic', directed by Geethu Mohandas, has been released. The film features Yash in a double role and is described as a larger-than-life action thriller with elements of a dark gangster drama, love, power, and revenge. Some reports highlight Yash's entry into film distribution with this project. The trailer launch event was attended by co-stars Nayanthara, Kiara Advani, and Huma Qureshi. Actor Yash referred to 'Toxic' as an 'Indian film', comparing its making to going to war.
